headline: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility in Tupelo, Mississippi, after Colonel Carlyle "Smitty" Harris.
what_it_does: The law officially names the Postal Service facility at 500 West Main Street, Suite 102 in Tupelo, Mississippi, as the Colonel Carlyle "Smitty" Harris Post Office. It changes only the name of the building and does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on August 6, 2021.
